title: Historical snapshot and export fail after source inventory limit
observed_evidence: Synthetic released snapshot: 200 before limit, 409 SOURCE_BATCH_REQUIRED for view/export when configured cap reduced; retained cells recover unchanged after reset. Native current-use checks call the bounded all-facility inventory.
exit_evidence_required: Historical approved cells remain readable/exportable with truthful unavailable or stale current-use status when source checking cannot run. Current policy/scope checks remain enforced. Add view/export/list/release tests at configured bounds; never label unknown source health as current.

title: All-period native scans and global reporting write lock limit growth
observed_evidence: Source scan caps all relevant-kind facility records at 5000 and events at 20000 before period selection. Reporting commands hold one global PostgreSQL advisory transaction lock, including extraction. Representative maximum-volume performance is not evidenced.
exit_evidence_required: Use bounded period/source indexes or qualified incremental/batch work with complete accounting and lock scoping. Measure actual cloud function memory/duration, simultaneous facilities, correction/replay, historical reads and adopted latency targets.

title: Private evidence upload lacks configured malware scanner
observed_evidence: Production project has no LWH_CLAMAV_HOST entry. storage.scan requires it and refuses uploads; private storage credentials alone do not qualify file acceptance.
exit_evidence_required: Qualify a permitted cloud-compatible scan workflow with clean/malicious/timeout cases, private object access and receipt lineage, or explicitly exclude file-dependent operation until resolved. Do not bypass scanning or invent accepted evidence.

title: Recovery is demonstrated but not an assured backup operating service
owner_role: Platform operations, security and independent recovery custodian
observed_evidence: 19 assurance records include manual backups/restores and a retained failed restore followed by success. The daily job handler does not schedule archive creation. Independent copy/custody and adopted RPO/RTO are not established.
exit_evidence_required: Adopt targets and ownership; schedule/monitor bounded backups within approved stack; independently protect copies/keys; rehearse representative DB/files/config/key recovery and reconcile open care/stock/finance before service resumption.

title: Actual hierarchy, facilities, criteria and independent operators are absent
suite_references: DHS-REQ-001; DHS-REQ-003; DHS-REQ-010; LWH-PRD-001; LWH-PRD-002; LWH-PRD-003
observed_evidence: Production counts: zero units, operators, facilities, criteria and applications; one account with PLATFORM_ADMIN and REGISTRY_STEWARD current grants only. No real reviewer/decider/clinical team can yet exercise separation of duties.
exit_evidence_required: Validate real Region-Zone identifiers/effective dates, nominate actual distinct role holders and backups, onboard an approved facility/operator and adopt applicable affiliation criteria/calendar. Obtain real invitation details rather than fabricate staff.

title: Proposed reporting forms are available but none are operationally adopted
suite_references: DHS-REQ-005; DHS-REQ-006; DHS-REQ-016; LWH-PRD-004; LWH-SPEC-007; LWH-SPEC-008
observed_evidence: Three working forms contain 22 configurations across 21 distinct metric IDs; four native mappings are a separate edition. Production definitions, obligations, policies and returns all number zero.
exit_evidence_required: Approve or replace the user-authorised proposals, establish actual source/coverage/calendar/expected units and disclosure decisions, independently adopt versions and demonstrate a real-role return through review/release. Original forms are not an engineering prerequisite while unavailable.

title: Daily bounded scheduling is not minute-level clinical escalation
owner_role: Clinical operations and platform duty lead
observed_evidence: Actual API deployment cron is 0 0 * * *. Handler runs a bounded job tick plus invitation/exception work. No continuous worker host or actual staffed clinical response is established.
exit_evidence_required: Record actual staffed primary/fallback coverage and tested acknowledgement/escalation within adopted service commitments. Qualify cloud-compatible scheduling or explicitly restrict unsupported urgent-response promises; queue delivery is not clinician acknowledgement.

title: Country, operator, custodian and service activation evidence is unpopulated
owner_role: Clinical, privacy, records, legal and finance owners
observed_evidence: Production policy packages, clinical sites/privileges and personal receiving services all number zero. Activation enforcement defaults true; infrastructure READY is not service authorisation.
exit_evidence_required: Select an actual pilot scope and adopt operator/custodian, professional authority, processing locations, retention/rights, clinical content/manual practice, response and funding decisions. Independently review and record a scoped activation decision; do not infer it from deployment.

title: Formal requirements and role-based UAT lack executed acceptance mapping
owner_role: QA, product and actual domain reviewers
observed_evidence: Canonical 200 requirements and 111 specified cases remain NOT_RUN. Existing register has 57 partial engineering rows and 143 requiring requirement-level qualification; 221 passing Python tests are not 221 accepted suite requirements.
exit_evidence_required: Map each requirement/form/state/journey to exact implementation and executed evidence, record owners and approved exceptions, and execute nominated-role Director loop and enabled clinical journeys. Keep specification, engineering verification and human acceptance distinct.

title: Independent security/privacy and operational key/rights controls remain unqualified
observed_evidence: MFA, scoped server permissions, encrypted data/history and negative tests exist. Independent penetration/privacy assessment, off-account key/copy custody, rotation/retirement and adopted rights/retention operating evidence are absent.
exit_evidence_required: Complete threat/dependency/access/disclosure review and targeted penetration tests; qualify key rotation and old-record/backup recovery, rights/custody/exit handling and monitored incident response under actual adopted policies.

title: Referral/readiness loop does not yet cover the full required network workflow
observed_evidence: Native actions are REQUEST, RECORD_ACCEPTANCE, TRANSFER, CLOSE and CANCEL. Explicit decline/unreachable/receipt/outcome variants and complete time-bounded network suitability are not implemented. CLOSE has no separate receiving-outcome evidence requirement. Patient interaction is human requests/reviewed releases, not a dedicated referral tracker.
exit_evidence_required: Implement and qualify actual receiving receipt/outcome, failure alternatives and retained sender/pending-care responsibility, suitable readiness matching and authorised patient-visible status. Acceptance and transport must remain distinct from completed receiving care.

title: Leadership defaults and programme portfolio remain partial
owner_role: Directorate information/programme owners and product engineering
observed_evidence: One role-filtered Directorate workspace provides released snapshots and owned actions; distinct senior strategic defaults, wider portfolio/milestones and observed leadership use are not complete.
exit_evidence_required: Demonstrate President/Executive Minister/Directorate/region/zone needs with appropriate concise defaults, coverage/freshness, disclosure-identical exports and evidence-linked accepted interventions/outcome review; do not expose raw charts by seniority.

title: Device, accessible and low-bandwidth operating journeys are not observed
observed_evidence: Browser-free client tests and a scoped patient PWA exist. Actual device installation, keyboard/screen-reader/zoom, low-bandwidth and wrong-subject/error-recovery UAT remain unobserved.
exit_evidence_required: Perform real-user/manual browser/device and accessibility qualification, including subject switches, drafts/conflicts, unavailable teams, source freshness and date/time entry. Respect the user instruction against Playwright installation.

title: Canonical form/field/screen/state and API parity has not been demonstrated
owner_role: Business analyst, domain engineers and QA
observed_evidence: The suite has 51 forms/355 fields, 75 screens and 30 state families. Native typed extensions are recorded, but complete field-level conformance/exception evidence is absent; screen/route counts cannot establish parity.
exit_evidence_required: Produce a field/state/route crosswalk with source, requiredness, type, permission, validation, missingness, persistence and test evidence; adopt explicit implementation extensions without rewriting baseline meanings.

title: Core care finance and sponsorship are incomplete beyond cash billing
observed_evidence: Native tariffs, invoices, actual cash receipts and balanced ledger exist; payer splits/claims/remittance, controlled refunds/reversals and qualified sponsorship entitlements/funding are not delivered. Optional ERP does not remove these core obligations.
exit_evidence_required: Implement authorised payer/entitlement and maker-checker adjustment flows with real settlement evidence, idempotency, per-currency balance and reconciliation. Use actual adopted counterpart contracts; no mock payment success. Keep optional ERP independent.

title: Governed assistance is not implemented by the free-model readiness probe
observed_evidence: OpenRouter fixed-public readiness and a shared control exist; clinical/institutional assistant use cases, permitted tools/memory, source-grounded drafts and governed evaluations do not.
exit_evidence_required: Register bounded use cases, approve data/provider/source handling, implement human-reviewed tools/drafts and representative safety/injection/AI-off evaluations. Free-only provider preference persists; no autonomous consequential decisions.

title: Full facility WAN-offline clinical runtime remains undelivered
observed_evidence: Cloud care requires WAN. The patient PWA stores no charts/drafts and provides public offline guidance only. Local authority/trust, complete durable LAN workflows, semantic sync/fencing and outage qualification are not delivered.
exit_evidence_required: Retain core debt explicitly. Once hosting scope is authorised, qualify all enabled local clinical/stock/finance journeys, identity/expiry, crash/restart, sync conflicts/revocation and fenced restore. Do not claim full-suite readiness from a cloud-only scope.

title: Selected-facility interfaces and migration are not qualified
observed_evidence: Native LW Care is the available EMR. Permission-scoped source sharing/manual capture exist; actual FHIR/LIS/PACS/DICOM/device and legacy migration/cutover conformance are not claimed.
exit_evidence_required: Register/approve the facility first, then qualify its chosen integration or migration with real approved counterparts, mappings, reconciliation and safe rollback. No second EMR is a prerequisite for the native route.

title: Separate staging and enforced release/rollback evidence require hardening
observed_evidence: Two live cloud projects and isolated synthetic schemas/proofs exist; a separately qualified staging/provider sandbox and automatically enforced CI/approval/rollback path are not established by this audit. Legacy candidate applications remain in the repository.
exit_evidence_required: Qualify isolated staging within the current stack, explicit runtime selection, dependency/licence inventory, exact-artifact promotion and rollback preserving new data. Inventory/retire or fence legacy/demo surfaces without counting them as production capability.

title: Named ownership, funded support and competent operating handoff are missing
owner_role: Directorate sponsor, operator and managed-service owners
suite_references: LWH-GOV-001; LWH-OPS-005; LWH-OPS-007; LWH-COM-001; LWH-COM-002; LWH-COM-003
observed_evidence: The suite provides responsibility/contract/funding frameworks. This audit does not establish executed operating agreements, actual deputies, competence, funded support or adopted service targets.
exit_evidence_required: Nominate real accountable owners/deputies, agree clinical/technical/custody responsibilities and funding/support, train actual roles and witness incident/recovery/continuity drills before scoped activation.
